text: Rahul and Meera got engaged on the beach in Goa!! Wedding probably next spring. Must send them something nice this week.
Amir's knee op is Thursday at St Mary's. He'll be on crutches for about six weeks so no five a side till after Christmas.
anjali bday june 3rd. into pottery lately, mentioned a wheel class voucher would be amazing

Owen called on the way home from the ward. His dad's back in hospital, chest infection again, third time this year, and they're talking about moving him to a care home once he's discharged. Owen's been doing nights there and sounds completely wiped out, his boss is being decent about it though. His brother Joseph is flying in from Dublin on Friday to take over for a bit. Ring Owen Saturday to see how he's holding up.
Henrik and his wife Ann celebrating 25 years on May 14. Big dinner at the boathouse, we're invited. I'm bringing the wine.
Victor mentioned he's allergic to shellfish, worth remembering for the anniversary dinner
so um Milan was saying his sister Rosa is having her gallbladder out next Tuesday and she's pretty scared about the anaesthetic, first time she's ever been under. I should text her the night before
Kemal's wedding is off. He and Giulia split up last month, he's staying at his brother's for now. Didn't want to talk about it much.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow, suit for the 5/22 wedding.
Ayo turns 40 on Saturday. Surprise party at Ivan's flat, 8pm. Ivan says don't mention it to her husband either, he can't keep a secret. Chipping in for the record player she's had her eye on.
Jorge back from hospital, appendix out last Friday. Recovering at home, bored out of his mind. Drop round some books next week?
Natasha - vegan, hates cilantro, obsessed with bouldering. Birthday is 8/9.
Ignacio proposed to Francesca in Lisbon last weekend! She said yes obviously. Engagement drinks Friday after next.
Ravi had his cataract surgery yesterday. Remind me to call him tomorrow and check his eye's ok.
Carlos keeps hinting about a new road bike for his 50th. Bit pricey, maybe the lads go in together. His birthday's October 30.
Kaito's wife Rin is expecting! Due around March 12. They found out the day after their anniversary, which is sweet.

Luca's mum had a fall at the weekend, broke her hip. The op went ok on Monday but she's in for at least another week and then needs rehab. He's driving up and down to Leeds every day after work and he's exhausted, plus his wife Giulia is away with work till the 15th so he's juggling the kids too. Maybe offer to have the boys after school Thursday.
anya - loves jigsaws, 1000 piece ones, and anything with cats. her cat Biscuit just turned 10
Damian's MRI is on the 17th. Results usually take a fortnight. He's trying not to think about it.
Dong and his partner Louis are renewing their vows in Santorini this summer, July 8th I think. Ask Louis if they want us there or if it's just family.
Joseph retiring end of next month after 30 years at the council. Leaving do on the 28th, need to sign the card before Wednesday.
Siddharth's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral's Thursday in Birmingham. Send flowers to the family.
Gemma's having her wisdom teeth out Monday. Already stocking up on ice cream and Netflix lol
Called Henrik back. Ann's biopsy came back clear!! So relieved for them both. They're off to Norway in a fortnight to celebrate.
Rahul says Meera's into gardening big time now, wants a greenhouse. Could be a good engagement gift idea.
Note to self - book GP appointment for my back, ask about physio. Also renew passport before the June trip.
Amir texted from the ward, op done, all fine. Says the hospital food is criminal. I should bring him proper biryani when he's home on Monday.
Owen's daughter Gemma graduates from nursing school May 20th. He's beyond proud. She's applying to the children's hospital.
Milan's anniversary is Friday and he's completely forgotten to book anything. Told him to try the Italian on the high street.

voice memo: right so at lunch with Anjali and Ravi, Anjali said her brother Kemal is getting married on September 6th in Istanbul and the whole family's flying out the week before, she's stressing about the speech because she's maid of honour no wait she said she's doing a reading, anyway she's nervous, and Ravi mentioned his mum's hip replacement got moved to November 2nd, so that's a while to wait for her. Don't forget to ask Anjali how the reading practice is going next week.
Victor's dog Pepper had surgery on her leg Wed, he's been sleeping on the sofa with her. Check in with him on the weekend.
Natasha's mum's 70th is this weekend. Natasha's planning a garden party and freaking out about the weather.
Giulia mentioned she's starting a sommelier course in January, she's really into natural wines. Good to know for her birthday on 2/14, she always jokes it's the worst birthday date.
Cancelled dinner with Jorge Tuesday, his surgery got brought forward to Monday. Rescheduling for after he's recovered.

Ivan rang this morning, Anya got the all clear after eight months of treatment. He was teary on the phone, kept saying he couldn't believe it. They're planning a weekend away at the end of the month, somewhere by the sea, and it's their wedding anniversary on November 9 so they might push it to then. Anya wants to get back to her choir and her allotment. I should send her flowers, something bright.
Ayo loved the record player!! Party was brilliant. She said next year she wants to go to Lagos for her birthday.
Ignacio had his hernia repair done, said recovery is slower than he expected. He's back at work April 3rd hopefully.
Ugh forgot Francesca's birthday was yesterday. Must call her tonight and grovel. She's into film photography, maybe get her some Portra rolls.

Kaito filled me in over coffee. Dr Nakamura said his dad needs a triple bypass, date tbc, probably early next month, and he'll be in for about ten days after. Kaito's trying to stay positive but he's clearly struggling, not sleeping, and work is piling on. His sister Rin is flying in from Osaka on Thursday to help with their mum. Need to check in with him next week and maybe drop off some food.
Carlos and Rosa - wedding anniversary June 11. 10 years. Tin? Check what 10 is.
Luca says his son starts nursery on Monday. Unrelated but he's also taken up sourdough, very into it.
Meera's sister is getting married 4/26, in a castle apparently. Meera's a bridesmaid and the dress fittings are driving her mad.
Damian called, results back, it's nothing serious, just a cyst. Mrs Moreau (his mum) is visiting from Lyon for the weekend to fuss over him.
Dong - collects vintage cameras, Leica especially. Doesn't drink. Birthday sometime in August, ask Louis for exact date.
Need to write thank you cards from the party this weekend. And return Siddharth's gazebo before Thursday.

Joseph's wife Ann had a minor stroke last Wednesday. Thankfully caught early, she's home now but can't drive for a month and her left hand is still weak. Joseph's taking her to all her physio sessions, Tuesdays and Fridays at 10, on top of his retirement handover at work. Their daughter is coming down from Glasgow for the weekend. Offer to do one of the Friday runs so he gets a break.
Owen and his partner are celebrating their anniversary in Paris, flying out next Thursday, back the following Tuesday.

Henrik turns 60 on 11/3. Ann says he's been dropping hints about a fly fishing rod for months, the carbon ones, and he also loves whisky, Islay ones especially, Laphroaig. She's planning a small dinner at theirs the Saturday before, just close friends, and wants to keep the actual day quiet because his brother passed away around that time a few years ago and it's still hard for him.
just met Rahul's cousin Anya at the engagement party, she's a nurse at the Royal, lives in Clapham
Amir's physio is going well, he's off the crutches. Says he's training for the 10k in May now, mad man.
Gemma Williams from work has her IVF appointment on the 19th, she's really anxious about it. Don't make a big deal but maybe a quiet message that morning.

Talked to Siddharth for ages after squash. His sister Francesca got engaged on her birthday, June 2nd, to a guy called Louis Moreau who she met at uni. Siddharth's not sure about him yet, says he's a bit flash, but their mum adores him. Their parents are throwing an engagement party in three weeks at the house and Siddharth's been roped into doing the barbecue. Wedding's pencilled in for next summer, possibly in France where Louis's family live.
Ravi's mum's hip op went fine. She's up and walking with a frame already, two days later! Ravi says she's demanding to go home.
Rosa is recovering well from the gallbladder op. Back at work Monday. She's taking up swimming once the stitches are out.
Kemal's grandmother turns 100 on December 1st!! Family's getting a letter from the King sorted. Kemal's organising a big lunch.
Remind me to ask Ivan how Anya's check up went on Friday.
Weekend sorted: Saturday morning hospital visit with Victor to see his dad, Sat night Natasha's 30th, Sunday lunch at mum's. Monday dentist at 9.

Natasha's 30th was so fun. Her boyfriend Ignacio did a speech, she cried, everyone cried. They've just booked their first holiday together, Japan in April, two weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto. Ignacio quietly told me he's bringing a ring and planning to propose in Kyoto, so absolutely do not say anything. Natasha mentioned she's been wanting a decent camera for the trip, might be a nice belated present from us.
Milan said his nephew is having grommets put in next Wednesday, he's only four. Milan's sister is beside herself. Ask him on Thursday how the little guy got on.
Carlos, aka Charlie to everyone at golf, said his 50th is now a weekend in Seville, Oct 30 to Nov 2. Need to book flights by Friday before prices jump.
